audit.whatIsWrong: phases[2..6].side read 'Skill' while content win[2..5] read Qiyana and win[6] read Azir; packet.levelChart agrees with the content layer. Five rows disagreed across layers.
audit.why: Content and packet agree. The kit supports Qiyana holding the lane: two dashes (Terrashape 1100 range on 7s, Audacity 650 on 11s falling to 7s) against an immobile 740-range caster whose escape is 22s at rank 1. 47.42% over 310 games is a lane you lose and then out-scale at two items.
audit.corrected: phases[2..5].side -> Qiyana, phases[6].side -> Azir, with every .why in the group rewritten to match.

audit.why: Her spikes are level 3 (both dashes plus an element) and level 6 Supreme Display of Talent — 950 range, flat 120s, knock-up and stun. Azir's are Nashor's Tooth and Emperor's Divide (120/105/90s).
audit.corrected: breakdown.spikes and phases[4].why now carry the 950-range stun and its flat cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: The matchup told you 'once Audacity is spent she cannot reach you'. That is false and it is the most dangerous line on the page — Terrashape is also a dash, 1100 range, on 7 seconds flat.
audit.why: Riot's text for W: 'Qiyana dashes to a location and enchants her weapon with an element.' So Audacity down is not safety; both dashes have to be spent. Second: Audacity 'dashes to an enemy' — a minion is an enemy, so the wave she is standing behind is a ladder she can climb to reach you. Third, the range fact the page never used: her Q reaches 525 against a Sand Soldier's 740.
audit.corrected: tldr, winCon, breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t and phases[1].why rewritten around both dashes; the 525-vs-740 gap written into tradeGood and phases[0].why.

audit.why: Audacity 11/10/9/8/7, Terrashape 7 flat, Elemental Wrath 7 flat, Supreme Display of Talent 120 flat, Shifting Sands 22/20.5/19/17.5/16.
audit.corrected: All of those now appear in breakdown.cooldowns, dontsFull[0].d and the phase rows.

notes: CHART: phases[2..6].side were the stale token 'Skill'; content win[] and packet.levelChart already agreed on Qiyana through first item then Azir, so the full layer was moved onto them and every .why in the group rewritten in this same proposal. No paired win[N] edit exists to propose — win[N] is already correct on disk for all five rows. Ratings untouched. BIGGEST FIX: the page repeatedly claimed that once Audacity is spent 'she cannot reach you'. Terrashape is a 1100-range dash on a flat 7 seconds, so that advice walks a reader straight into the gap-close. Also corrected: Audacity dashes to an ENEMY, so minions are usable as stepping stones. CONTENT-LAYER whys[] LOOK MISALIGNED and I did NOT touch them: whys[1] (the Level 2 row) describes her Ultimate and Azir's level 6 spike, and whys[2] talks about levels 4-5 — the array reads as though it is shifted by roughly one row relative to its labels. Fixing that would mean rewriting all seven at once on a guess about which row each string belongs to, so it is recorded here instead. DELIBERATELY UNASSERTED: whether Supreme Display of Talent can detonate the terrain created by Emperor's Divide. Both are flagged 'terrain' in the kit data, which would make it a decisive interaction if true, but nothing in Riot's text settles it and I will not speculate on a live page.
